en.title: GTA 6: Sam Houser Pulls Out of Interview; Release Date Confirmed
en.summary: Rockstar Games co-founder Sam Houser has unexpectedly withdrawn from a highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6 interview. Meanwhile, Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick has officially confirmed the game's release window.
en.body:
The road to **Grand Theft Auto 6** has been long and filled with speculation, but a recent development has added a layer of mystery to its promotional cycle. **Sam Houser**, co-founder and president of Rockstar Games, has reportedly withdrawn from an exclusive interview concerning the highly anticipated title. The reason cited for his withdrawal is "personal reasons," a statement that offers little insight into the situation but emphasizes its private nature.

This news comes at a crucial juncture as fans eagerly await more concrete details about **GTA 6**. Houser's involvement in interviews typically provides invaluable context and behind-the-scenes glimpses into Rockstar's creative process, making his absence a point of interest. However, the broader **Grand Theft Auto** franchise has a history of maintaining a degree of mystique, often letting the games speak for themselves.

## Release Date Confirmed Amidst Interview News

Despite the personal reasons behind **Sam Houser's** withdrawal, the commercial future of **GTA 6** remains on solid ground. **Strauss Zelnick**, chairman and CEO of Take-Two Interactive, the parent company of Rockstar Games, has officially confirmed the release window for **Grand Theft Auto 6**. During a recent earnings call, Zelnick stated that the game is slated for release on November 19th, 2026. This date was announced shortly before the earnings call, ensuring that despite any internal shifts, the business side of **Rockstar's** flagship title remains firmly on track.

This confirmation is a significant piece of information for the global fanbase. While the exact day might be subject to change, a specific year and even a target date provide a tangible goal for players worldwide who have been speculating about **GTA 6's** launch for years. The game, set to be the first new **Grand Theft Auto** title since 2013's **GTA V**, is expected to be a monumental release, pushing the boundaries of open-world gaming on current-generation consoles.

## Fan Reaction and What's Next

News of **Sam Houser's** cancelled interview has naturally sparked discussion within the **GTA** community. While the reasons are personal and deserve respect, fans are understandably curious. The focus, however, quickly shifts back to the confirmed 2026 release date. This provides a clear marker for when players can expect to return to the world of **Grand Theft Auto**. The anticipation for **GTA 6** is immense, fueled by trailer reveals and the enduring legacy of the franchise.

With the release date now officially set for November 19th, 2026, the next steps will involve further official announcements from Rockstar Games regarding gameplay details, platform specifics, and potentially more glimpses into the game's world and characters. The industry and fans alike will be watching closely for any further updates from the studio.

content_raw: Rockstar Games co-founder and president Sam Houser has withdrawn from an exclusive Grand Theft Auto 6 interview due to “personal reasons”.
